name: Headman Manor
summary: An old western-style mansion on several floors, with blind corners and narrow corridors.
lighting: Dim interiors with lots of shadowy corners.
hiding: Good. Lots of rooms, doors and furniture.

early: Blind corners hide monsters until you're right on them
Narrow corridors: a monster can block your only way back to the truck
mid: Hidden drops start to appear, sometimes right past a door
Multi-floor routes get longer, so plan the cart path between floors
late: Drops right behind doors, so look before you sprint through

tips: You can move the cart between floors without damaging heavy valuables if you're careful
Scout a second route back to the truck in case a corridor gets blocked

name: McJannek Station
summary: A dim arctic research station with broad corridors, open rooms and multi-floor drops.
lighting: Dim. Open rooms give monsters long sightlines.
hiding: Poor. Fewer hiding spots than the manor.

early: Open rooms: sight-based monsters spot you from far away
Stairs can damage loads, so slow down with the cart
mid: Long open corridors make you an easy target for the Clown laser and Huntsman shots
late: Deadly pits and liquid pools that need parkour
Multi-floor drops on the extraction route

tips: Move between cover, because open halls are kill zones for ranged monsters
Carry the most fragile loot by hand over stairs instead of in the cart

name: Swiftbroom Academy
summary: A castle-like wizarding school full of sudden stairs, pits and lava.
lighting: Mixed. Torch-lit halls with dark side rooms.
hiding: Medium. Monsters are hard to shake once they spot you.

early: Death pits can show up even at low quota
Sudden stairs can tip the cart
mid: Lava pools on the way to valuables
Any push, throw or scream near an edge can be fatal
late: Extraction rooms with lava pits: one fall is basically death
Monsters that push or throw (Bowtie, Upscream, Mentalist) become lethal

tips: Lava and pits are great for disposing of Bangers
Never fight next to a ledge here, so pull monsters into flat rooms first

name: Museum of Human Art
summary: A very dark, abandoned art museum with open galleries, pits and vents.
lighting: Very dark. Your flashlight is most of your light.
hiding: Poor. Open galleries with few hiding spots.

early: Darkness hides monsters until they're close, so listen carefully
Valuables on high ledges tempt risky jumps
mid: Flashlight dependence: light-sensitive monsters (Headman, Oogly) are worse here
late: Pits plus darkness plus long galleries make chases deadly

tips: Vents are escape routes, but you can't carry loot through them
Call out gallery names so the team can find each other in the dark

name: Sunstone Valley Resort
summary: A dark Gold Rush western resort with minecart tracks, attractions, vertical rooms and breakable walkways. Added in v0.5.0.
hiding: Medium. Indoor facilities, narrow corridors and elevation changes.

mid: Overfilled carts near drops can lose several valuables at once
late: Pony territory: ceilings and drops combine badly

tips: Don't overfill the cart on walkway routes
Look up, because ceiling attackers love this map's tall rooms
